The place is very clean, especially the restrooms. There are toothbrushes available. I came in for a filling because the old filling had chipped and fallen out. Another dentist recommended a crown/root canal treatment, but the dentist here (Dr. Phung) said the root was still normal, so she repaired the filling and will monitor the situation. In short, coming here in the first place would have been better. You can drive into the alley next to the clinic and park in the lot behind the clinic (10 baht parking fee). I usually come here regularly, but after moving, I tried other places, but I would definitely drive back here for my dental work.

The female dentist, who wore glasses, was very heavy-handed. She inserted and removed the mouth-opening instrument without any prior warning. For example, she didn't say anything like, "I'm about to remove the mouth-opening tool." She also left the suction device in my mouth, which almost caused me to vomit three times. Even at a government-run clinic, the staff never left a suction device in my mouth like that. After the procedure, I had abrasions on the corner of my mouth from the mouth-opening tool and the instruments rubbing against it. My gums were swollen. The staff told me to buy mouth ointment from a pharmacy; it only costs a few tens of baht. Instead of offering me water, tea, or coffee, wouldn't it be more considerate and responsible for the cost of the mouth ointment?

I am the administrator of Khwanjai Dental Clinic. I would like to use this space to clarify your review, kan saibua. If only the crown had come loose, we would guarantee to reattach it free of charge. However, in this case, not only was the crown loose, but the post was also missing. Therefore, a new post had to be made, and there was only the cost of the new post itself. (The dentist also gave a discount out of consideration for the patient.) The crown reattachment was done free of charge, as per our guarantee.

Allow me to use an analogy to illustrate further: Imagine buying a new mobile phone. After using it for a while, it gets bumped, and the phone case comes off (comparable to the crown coming loose). You can't put the case back on yourself, so you take it to a shop. When the technician inspects the phone, they find that the battery is missing (comparable to the post). The shop recommends buying a new battery and installing it before putting the case back on. They also give you a discount because you've purchased multiple phones from them. Then, the technician installs the new battery and case, and you only pay for the new battery, not the service fee for reattaching the case. That's a similar scenario. ^^

P.S. This applies to cases where the crown has come loose. Our clinic guarantees free crown placement for 6 months from the date of crown placement. In fact, our dentists are often generous enough to extend the guarantee to 1 year. If the crown comes loose after the warranty period has expired, there will be a charge of 500-800 baht for crown placement.

I once had a cracked tooth and got a filling elsewhere, but it fell out after 7 days. I had to come here to get it fixed, and since then I've been a regular customer. The place is small but clean, and the staff are polite and very attentive. I had my wisdom tooth extracted by a male doctor (I don't remember his name). I was very scared, so he applied numbing cream beforehand, which helped a lot. After the extraction, I didn't feel any pain or swelling. I've recommended many friends here for wisdom tooth extractions and orthodontics. I'm currently getting braces from Dr. Busarin; she's very skilled and kind.
It's really good. I've used their services many times. The quality is excellent!

I had an appointment to have my wisdom tooth extracted on July 18th, 2020 at 3:00 PM. After waiting for a month, I called the day before the appointment to check, and was told the doctor was on leave. I was surprised they didn't call to inform me. When I checked my appointment book, my name wasn't there. I had already taken time off work. I'm very disappointed. The system is terrible.

My dad had permanent crowns done for his entire mouth, costing hundreds of thousands of baht. However, after only a few months, some teeth fell out. They said there was a 6-month warranty before the procedure. When he went back for repairs, the dentist said he had to pay an additional 4,500 baht because the post had come loose. Doesn't the 6-month warranty cover everything? This clinic has 5-star ratings – I wish them wealth and prosperity, and may their business last a long time! 🙏🏼😬

Also, if you promise a warranty when the work is done at your clinic, and then later make excuses, please explain everything clearly so we don't waste our money.
